task: Core 1186 U06: Pro-only Digital Office e-mail attachment HTTP endpoints and shared source-specific downloads, preserving Team Chat attachments and Alap transactional email

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The direct HTTP attachment routes and shared download are reachable without rendering the Pro-only Office page. Adversarial, pairwise, failure and finite-state checks cover Alap/Pro, Team Chat and source type, explicit RBAC, tenant isolation and 403 responses. Assurance is bounded to four HTTP endpoints; storage/RPC and downgrade remain unresolved release units.

acceptanceCriteria: Prepare, scan, status guard with hasCurrentPlanFeature(officeCommunicationAdvanced), status 403, before tenant-scoped RPC or scan work.
Shared private download maps internal_upload to teamChatSecureAttachments and provider_inbound/customer_outbound to officeCommunicationAdvanced with unknown source fail-closed.
The shared download source is resolved from tenant-scoped metadata; no error path exposes metadata to unauthorized Alap.
Chat attachment upload/download behavior and Team Chat entitlement remain unchanged.
Alap support/officeCommunication remains enabled; Alap advanced Office absent, Pro advanced present; transactional email pipeline unchanged.

All target tests including adversarial negative cases, Plan Before Code, Knowledge/Deep Atlas, Reference/Implementation Sync, Incremental Replay, Release Risk, exact-head CI, external-proofs where required, Completion Truth, Lifecycle PASS.
invariants: Authentication and support.manage RBAC are required in the email upload endpoints prior to plan gate.
Current plan feature must be checked on each direct request; no reliance on parent route.
Shared download must not permit an unknown source or mismatch instance scope.
No change to email sending, order notifications, suppression or feature entitlement catalog.
Main CI/production and staging customer data are protected; no fresh installs or migrations in this unit.
forbiddenStates: An Alap tenant can reserve, scan, poll or download Office email attachments by hitting an API directly.
A Team Chat file becomes inaccessible due to the Office email-specific Pro gate.
An unknown metadata source defaults to an allowed feature.
The shared route discloses tenant metadata before authentication/tenant scope.
The parent issue is marked DONE based only on HTTP guard tests without RPC/storage audit.

failureModes: Branch mapping accidentally overconstrains Team Chat
One of scan/status callers retains base entitlement
Alap customer order emails broken by broad plan catalog change
edgeCases: Forged POST to prepare without rendering UI
Forgery sends existing draft ID to scan under Alap
Status GET with Alap support.manage present
Download provider_inbound from Alap despite valid UUID
Download customer_outbound from Alap despite valid UUID
internal_upload file from Team Chat Pro tenant
Plan downgrade while still holding old signed client upload request

semanticExecutionRoute.request: Core 1186 U06: Pro-only Digital Office e-mail attachment HTTP endpoints and shared source-specific downloads, preserving Team Chat attachments and Alap transactional email

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The Digital Office Pro-only route and Server Actions are guarded, but direct e-mail attachment prepare/scan/status APIs accept Alap base officeCommunication. A shared download route selects the base feature for provider_inbound and customer_outbound sources while internal_upload Team Chat downloads use a separate Pro gate. Protect e-mail HTTP boundaries without blocking normal Alap transactional mail or unrelated chat.
observableOutcomes: All three e-mail attachment HTTP endpoints reject Alap via status 403 using canonical officeCommunicationAdvanced before tenant context, storage, RPC or response payloads.
The shared private attachment download requires officeCommunicationAdvanced for provider_inbound and customer_outbound sources and retains teamChatSecureAttachments for internal_upload.
Normal Alap base email/support entitlements, suppression and transactional commerce email pipelines remain unchanged.
Real schema/source-specific negative tests and canonical Control Plane Truth must demonstrate the narrow surface; parent #1186 remains PARTIAL for RPC/RLS/storage/downgrade evaluation.
unresolvedRisks: Direct HTTP invocation bypasses server-rendered Digital Office route protection.
A generic blanket Pro gate on shared downloads could unintentionally alter Team Chat grants.
The shared metadata query uses service DB before source authorization; it must remain tenant-scoped and never disclose metadata before gate.
Other RPC/storage authorization and downgrade paths remain independent release obligations.

in: Three email-attachment HTTP endpoints (prepare, scan, status) and source-specific shared attachment download gate
Adversarial regression tests for Alap/Pro and distinct internal_upload Team Chat source
out: Alter catalog entitlements or Alap transactional commerce email/suppression
Database, RLS, storage bucket, worker and RPC privilege rework (subsequent issue unit)
